playbooks.title: From the customer meeting to the renewal
playbooks.goal: Prepare a customer call, secure the renewal and follow up on open points.

steps.why: Gives an overview of contracts, deadlines, offers, consumption and tickets before the meeting.
Shows which contracts expire soon and where the notice period is tight.
Creates the draft quote from the renewal.
Turns open customer topics into cleanly described service requests.

playbooks.title: Customer with problems: prepare the escalation
playbooks.goal: Capture a customer problem cleanly, know the contract framework and do not endanger the renewal.

steps.why: Records the problem as a complete service ticket.
Shows contract, service level, tickets and consumption for the conversation.
Checks whether the problem affects an upcoming renewal.

playbooks.title: Review expenses and invoices
playbooks.goal: Check expense receipts and match invoices against purchase orders and rules.

steps.why: Checks expenses against the travel policy.
Finds conspicuous receipts in Concur.
Matches invoices with purchase orders and goods receipts.

playbooks.title: Close the sprint and announce the release
playbooks.goal: Summarise the sprint, write release notes and keep an eye on quotas.

steps.why: Summarises what happened in the sprint.
Macht daraus Release-Notes.
Checks whether the BTP quotas are enough for the release.

playbooks.title: AI governance for the board
playbooks.goal: Review agents with too many permissions and prepare the result as a board briefing.

steps.why: Collects agents with too many permissions for the access review.
Shows whether the underlying automations run healthily.
Summarises risks, agents and budget on one page.

playbooks.title: Plan and review a campaign
playbooks.goal: Design a campaign and review the posts before publication.

steps.why: Creates the campaign briefing.
Checks posts against guidelines.

playbooks.title: Vom Interesse zum Lead
playbooks.goal: Capture a new signal, score the lead and assign it to the right sales rep.

steps.why: Turns a form, event or mail into a clean entry and detects duplicates.
Scores the lead transparently by ICP fit and BANT.
Assigns the lead by rules and names the matching rule.

playbooks.title: From the opportunity to the plan
playbooks.goal: Prepare an opportunity, clarify stakeholders and risks and answer a tender.

steps.why: Gives an overview of contracts, offers and tickets before the conversation.
Turns it into a plan with stakeholders, competition, risks and next steps.
Answers the question list from earlier answers and flags gaps.

playbooks.title: Vom Angebot zum Abschluss
playbooks.goal: Create a quote, check price and approval and assess the risk of the deal.

steps.why: Drafts the quote text from contract and offer data.
Checks discount and approval against the deal desk threshold.
Summarises warning signals from the quote, calls and mails.

playbooks.title: Review and hand over the contract
playbooks.goal: Check the contract against the standard, hand it over to Service and keep an eye on deadlines.

steps.why: Compares the contract with the standard positions and lists deviations.
Creates the handover to Service as a clean ticket.
Notes notice periods and the end of the term.

playbooks.title: Interest to contract: the whole way
playbooks.goal: Accompany the whole sales process from first interest to the reviewed contract with approvals.

steps.why: Captures the first signal and detects duplicates.
Scores the lead with an explainable score.
Plans the opportunity with stakeholders and steps.
Checks price, discount and approval of the quote.
Checks the contract before signature.
Summarises all stages for the weekly round.

playbooks.title: Opportunity absichern
playbooks.goal: Substantiate an opportunity: qualify by MEDDPICC, position the competition and calculate the business case.

steps.why: Shows what is supported and what is missing for the discovery call.
Positions the competitor and delivers questions and objection answers.
Calculates costs and payback with open assumptions.

playbooks.title: Security and handover
playbooks.goal: Answer the security questionnaire and hand over cleanly to Service after closing.

steps.why: Answers from data what is supported and forwards the rest.
Creates the handover and the 90-day plan.
Creates the handover as a ticket.

playbooks.title: After the customer call
playbooks.goal: Follow up on a call: CRM suggestions, mail draft and risk in view.

steps.why: Turns notes into CRM suggestions, actions and a mail draft.
Checks whether the call changes the risk of the deal.

capabilities.label: Content & communication

capabilities.label: IT operations & delivery
capabilities.blurb: Watch cloud capacity and keep sprints and releases on track.

capabilities.label: Skills & knowledge

capabilities.label: Sales pipeline
